description: Defines the NCCLDevCommManager class for managing NCCL device communicators in distributed GPU operations, including creation, retrieval, and cleanup of communicators, with support for different NCCL versions.

classes.name: NCCLDevCommManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing NCCL device communicators for distributed GPU communication.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NCCLDevCommManager for a given device.

methods.name: get_devcomm
methods.description: Retrieves the device communicator for a specified group.

methods.name: get_comm
methods.description: Retrieves the host-side communicator for a specified group.

methods.name: try_emplace_devcomm
methods.description: Creates and caches a device communicator for a group if it does not already exist.
